question: Who Owns Benihana?
quick_answer: Benihana is owned by The ONE Group Hospitality, Inc., the company behind STK Steakhouse, which completed a $365 million purchase of Benihana's parent (Safflower Holdings) in 2024. The ONE Group also owns the RA Sushi and Kona Grill brands. Benihana was founded in 1964 in New York City by Hiroaki 'Rocky' Aoki.
key_facts: Current owner: The ONE Group Hospitality (since 2024)

body.heading: Who owns Benihana now?
body.text: Benihana is owned by The ONE Group Hospitality, Inc., a US restaurant company best known for its STK Steakhouse brand. In 2024, The ONE Group completed a $365 million acquisition of Safflower Holdings, Benihana's parent company, adding Benihana along with the RA Sushi and Kona Grill brands to its portfolio.

body.heading: Ownership history
body.text: Benihana was founded in 1964 in New York City by Hiroaki 'Rocky' Aoki, a Japanese immigrant, who turned tableside teppanyaki cooking into dinner-and-a-show. The company was publicly traded for years, then bought by private-equity firm Angelo Gordon & Co. in 2012, before The ONE Group's 2024 purchase.

body.heading: What the new ownership means
body.text: Under The ONE Group, Benihana sits alongside other upscale and Japanese-themed dining brands. For guests, the tableside hibachi experience and the menu are unchanged; the ownership mainly affects the company's finances and growth plans.

faqs.q: Did The ONE Group buy Benihana?
faqs.a: Yes. The ONE Group Hospitality completed a $365 million acquisition of Benihana's parent company in 2024, so Benihana is now owned by The ONE Group.
Benihana was founded in 1964 in New York City by Hiroaki 'Rocky' Aoki, a Japanese immigrant who popularized teppanyaki dining in the US.
Benihana itself is not; it is owned by The ONE Group Hospitality. The ONE Group is a publicly traded company.
